note: Somalia, read on the Immigration and Citizenship Agency's own site (immigration.gov.so, Federal Government of Somalia), its home page and its Services page, on 2026-10-30. The Agency provides residence permits to foreign nationals who wish to live, work or invest in Somalia: temporary and permanent residence permits, work-based residency processing and permit renewals (renewable), on a valid passport and entry visa, an employer's or sponsor's letter where applicable and the application form. It also issues work permits for foreign nationals employed in Somalia (requirements not yet published: the work engine's). The page gives no fee, decision time, term, years to permanence or what work a permit allows, and doesn't say whether one applies from abroad, so none is written; that the requirements name an entry visa isn't taken as saying where to apply. Federal Member States' own practice (Somaliland's, Puntland's) isn't read or written.
